title: Vaal Orb Reference
summary: A Vaal Orb corrupts an item: it can change modifiers, add sockets, or grant a Vaal skill, but the result is permanent and the item can no longer take normal currency. This guide covers valid targets, order of operations, and what to check first.
description: A source-linked reference for the Vaal Orb: corruption basics, valid targets, outcomes by item class, and decision guidance.
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team
imageAlt: Vaal Orb currency item icon - a menacing Vaal-infused corruption orb

sections.title: Quick answer
sections.callout: Corrupt only after quality, sockets, and normal crafts are finished, and only if you accept a permanent, unpredictable change.
calloutDetail: A corrupted item cannot take normal currency afterward.
Outcomes vary by item class; there is no guaranteed 'upgrade'.

answers.label: Use it
text: Use it last, on a finished item, when the upside is worth the permanent risk.

answers.label: Sell it
text: Sell it if the target is not yet finished or the risk is not worth it.

answers.label: Hold it
text: Hold it until every earlier craft step is done.

facts.label: After corruption
note: Only certain special currencies still apply.

sections.title: Corruption basics
paragraphs: Corruption is a permanent state. Once an item is corrupted, normal currency such as whetstones, scrap, or fusings can no longer be applied.
The exact effect depends on the item class: equipment, skill gems, and waystones each follow different rules, and the result is randomised.
bullets: Finish quality, sockets, and normal crafts before corrupting.
Confirm a replacement exists if the result is bad.

sections.title: Valid targets
note: Most non-unique and unique items can be corrupted; the limiting factor is what you can still do afterward.

rows.label: Already corrupted item
rows.note: Cannot corrupt again with a normal Vaal Orb.

items.label: Quality and sockets are final
checks: No further normal currency after corruption.
items.why: You lose the ability to finish the item normally.

items.label: Normal crafts are done
checks: No later fusings, chromatics, or scours.

items.label: Replacement exists
checks: A spare is in inventory or stash.
items.why: A bad roll can brick the item.
items.fix: Only corrupt with a real fallback.

items.label: Outcome understood for this class
items.why: Skill gems and waystones differ from gear.
items.fix: Read the outcomes section per class.

steps.label: Select the finished target
body: Confirm all earlier crafts are complete.

steps.label: Confirm the permanent change
body: The result is randomised and cannot be undone.

before: A normal, modifiable item with your finished crafts.
after: A corrupted item: changed modifiers or sockets, no further normal currency.
compare.note: The exact before-and-after depends on the item class; confirm against the current client.

rows.benefit: Possible stronger rolls or extra sockets
May become a Vaal version with extra effect
rows.audience: Players who want the Vaal skill

rows.risk: Can make the map harder or unrewarding

rows.loss: Locks the item before it is finished
rows.recommendation: Never corrupt your main slot early.
Usually hold unless the upside is clear.

sections.title: Best and worst targets
intro: Corrupt finished, replaceable items. Avoid your only working piece and anything still mid-craft.

builds.title: Finished spare gear
builds.description: Good target once quality, sockets, and crafts are final and a spare exists.

builds.title: Your only main weapon
builds.description: Bad target; corruption locks it before the build is complete.

entries.question: Why can I no longer use currency after corrupting?
summary: A player corrupted, then found normal currency greyed out.
editorialAnalysis: This is intended: corruption locks the item from normal currency.
officialAnswer: Finish all normal crafts before corrupting.

entries.question: Do skill gems corrupt like gear?
summary: A player expected the same result as equipment.
editorialAnalysis: Gems follow class-specific rules, not gear rules.
officialAnswer: Read the outcomes section for skill gems separately.

problems.symptom: Currency no longer applies after corruption
directAnswer: Corruption permanently locks the item from normal currency; this is expected.
checks: Finish all normal crafts before using a Vaal Orb.

directAnswer: A roll can be neutral; absence of visible change is not a failure.
